0.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_001
0.description: I don't recommend you go strolling around outside. If the lightning doesn't get you, the beasts will.
0.translation_description: Ti sconsiglio di passeggiare all’aperto. Se non ti prende un fulmine, ci penseranno le bestie.

1.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_002
1.description: How goes the hunt, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? If you're here to try your hand against the local fauna, I might be able to tell you a thing or two about them.
1.translation_description: Come va la caccia, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Se vuoi affrontare la fauna locale, posso raccontarti qualcosa su di lei.

3.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_A1_000_001
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Gallowsbeak)
3.translation_description: Parlami del marchio d'élite di grado B. (Becco del Patibolo)

4.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_A1_000_002
4.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Gargant)
4.translation_description: Parlami del marchio d'élite di grado B. (Gargant)

5.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_A1_000_003
5.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Heshuala)
5.translation_description: Parlami del marchio d'élite di grado A. (Heshuala)

6.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_A1_000_004
6.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Urna Variabilis)
6.translation_description: Parlami del marchio d'élite di grado A. (Urna Variabilis)

7.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_A1_000_005
7.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Atticus the Primogenitor)
7.translation_description: Parlami del marchio d'élite di grado S. (Atticus il Primogenitore)

9.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_010
9.description: If you should come across an Alexandrian axe beak feeding its nestlings, you might think them kind and doting parents, sharing the day's spoils with their young just like any of us might.
9.translation_description: Se ti imbatti in un becco d’ascia alessandrino intento a nutrire i piccoli, potresti scambiarli per genitori premurosi che condividono il bottino del giorno con la prole, proprio come chiunque di noi.

10.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_011
10.description: But take a closer look at what's dangling from their jaws, and it paints a very different picture. They take their prey by the head, you see, and swing them by the neck till the last breath leaves them.
10.translation_description: Ma basta guardare cosa penzola loro dal becco per capire che la storia è diversa. Afferrano la preda per la testa e la scuotono per il collo finché non esala l’ultimo respiro.

11.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_012
11.description: The biggest ones with the hungriest chicks aren't satisfied with a single victim, oh no. They'll take half a dozen or more, all by the heads, and race back to their nests looking to all the world like a portable gallows after a roundup. Hence the name─and hence why we want these things dead.
11.translation_description: Gli esemplari più grossi, con i pulcini più voraci, non si accontentano di una sola vittima, nossignore. Ne prendono anche sei o più per la testa e tornano al nido, sembrando forche mobili dopo una retata. Ecco da dove viene il nome e perché vogliamo eliminarli.

12.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_020
12.description: You've seen an aerostat, right? The floating weapons platform? Well, the gargant is an advanced experimental model, intended to clear particularly pernicious vilekin nests with napalm bombs.
12.translation_description: Conosci gli aerostati, le piattaforme d’armi volanti? Il Gargant è un modello sperimentale avanzato, progettato per eliminare con bombe al napalm i nidi di vilomorfi particolarmente pericolosi.

13.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_021
13.description: Unfortunately for us, the experiment went wrong. Seems at some point it took a direct lightning strike to its identification circuitry, and ever since, it's targeted anything with a pulse for elimination.
13.translation_description: Purtroppo l’esperimento ci si è ritorto contro. A quanto pare, a un certo punto un fulmine ha colpito direttamente il suo sistema di identificazione e da allora prende di mira ogni essere vivente.

14.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_022
14.description: It took a whole cohort of the Alexandrian army to drive it away into the wilds, where it's since occupied itself burning everything in its path to cinders. If it were ever to make a return, even our regulators might not be enough to save us.
14.translation_description: Per scacciarlo nelle terre selvagge ci è voluta un’intera coorte dell’esercito alessandrino. Da allora brucia tutto ciò che incontra fino a ridurlo in cenere. Se tornasse, forse nemmeno i nostri regolatori basterebbero a salvarci.

15.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_030
15.description: The name means “child of thunder” in the Shetona tongue, and the creatures are true to it: they're literally born from lightning. We always have to be careful when a bolt falls nearby, lest it should conjure up one of these fiends.
15.translation_description: Nella lingua Shetona, il suo nome significa «prole del tuono», e gli esemplari sono fedeli al loro nome: nascono letteralmente dai fulmini. Dobbiamo sempre stare in guardia quando un fulmine cade nei dintorni, per evitare che generi una di queste bestiacce.

16.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_031
16.description: Back when they'd just finished building Yyupye's Halo, lightning struck one of the watering towers and brought one with it. A lot of folk who'd gathered for the grand unveiling lost their lives. This was before most Turali had made their peace with the regulators, so there was no bringing them back.
16.translation_description: Quando finirono di costruire l’Alone di Yyupye, un fulmine colpì una torre dell’acqua e ne generò uno. Molte delle persone accorse per l’inaugurazione persero la vita. All’epoca la maggior parte dei Turaliani non aveva ancora fatto pace con i regolatori, quindi non fu possibile riportarle in vita.

17.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_032
17.description: Would that you could say the same for the heshuala, but no─so long as the lightning keeps falling, they keep spawning. And so it falls to hunters like us to keep their numbers as close to zero as we can.
17.translation_description: Peccato che non si possa dire lo stesso degli heshuala: finché continuano a cadere fulmini, continuano a comparire. Spetta quindi a cacciatori come noi ridurne il numero il più possibile.

18.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_040
18.description: When Zoraal Ja became king, he ordered that all of Alexandria's weapons programs be massively accelerated. The engineers were under a lot of pressure and they made plenty of mistakes along the way. Urna Variabilis was one of them.
18.translation_description: Quando Zoraal Ja divenne re, ordinò di accelerare drasticamente tutti i programmi d’armamento di Alexandria. Gli ingegneri erano sotto pressione e commisero molti errori. Urna Variabilis fu uno di questi.

19.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_041
19.description: It was designed as a tactical unit to counter fast-moving forces: using a gravitational field to immobilize them, and a lightning beam to make sure they stayed that way. Unfortunately, it had one fatal flaw: its energy consumption was so high that it could only function in lands where the air was saturated with levin.
19.translation_description: Fu progettata come unità tattica per contrastare le forze rapide: avrebbe dovuto immobilizzarle con un campo gravitazionale e tenerle ferme con un raggio di fulmine. Aveva però un difetto fatale: consumava così tanta energia che poteva funzionare solo in terre dove l’aria era satura di etere fulmineo.

20.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_042
20.description: So the engineers switched their attentions to a different design─one that had a hope of working outside of Alexandria, as Zoraal Ja demanded. Problem is, in their rush, they forgot to turn the old experiment off. And so it continues its patrol, turning its ire on anyone or anything fleet-footed enough to be judged a legitimate target.
20.translation_description: Così gli ingegneri spostarono l’attenzione su un altro progetto, che forse avrebbe funzionato anche fuori da Alexandria, come pretendeva Zoraal Ja. Ma nella fretta dimenticarono di spegnere il vecchio esperimento. E così continua a pattugliare la zona, accanendosi contro chiunque o qualunque cosa sia abbastanza veloce da sembrare un bersaglio legittimo.

21.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_050
21.description: You know how Zoraal Ja introduced the idea of using feral souls in the regulators, so their wearers could gain the strength of powerful beasts? Well, it didn't just happen overnight. It took a lot of experimentation.
21.translation_description: Sai come Zoraal Ja introdusse l’idea di usare anime ferine nei regolatori, così che chi li indossa potesse acquisire la forza di bestie potenti? Ecco, non successe dall’oggi al domani: ci vollero molti esperimenti.

22.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_051
22.description: They needed to establish how the potency of the feral soul being assimilated translated into the empowerment of the subject, particularly at levels that invoked a physical transformation. It was this question that Atticus, a knight of the Alexandrian army, volunteered to answer.
22.translation_description: Dovevano capire come la potenza dell’anima ferina assimilata si traducesse nel potenziamento del soggetto, soprattutto quando questo subiva una trasformazione fisica. Atticus, cavaliere dell’esercito alessandrino, si offrì di rispondere a questa domanda.

23.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_052
23.description: The plan was to imbue him with souls until his flesh fully transformed─at which point they'd subject him to a barrage of tests to determine his newfound strength. As it turned out, no tests were needed─for when he awakened, he immediately tore a hole in the side of the holding facility and fled into the wilds.
23.translation_description: Il piano era infondergli anime finché il suo corpo non si fosse trasformato del tutto, poi sottoporlo a una serie di prove per misurare la nuova forza. Ma non servì alcun test: al risveglio, sfondò una parete della struttura di contenimento e fuggì nelle terre selvagge.

24.name: TEXT_CTSHNT70RISKYMOBHERITAGEFOUND_00902_LOANYINE_000_053
24.description: Naturally, this was all hushed up. It's only very recently that the details have started to trickle out─one of which being Atticus's apparently insatiable appetite for meat. Perhaps cooking up a big batch of barbecue might be enough to tempt him out from hiding?
24.translation_description: Naturalmente, misero tutto a tacere. Solo di recente i dettagli hanno cominciato a trapelare, tra cui l’insaziabile appetito di Atticus per la carne. Forse una bella grigliata basterebbe ad attirarlo fuori dal nascondiglio?
